item.title: Cash remains dominant in Fort Worth; digital payments lag
item.description: Fort Worth is lagging behind other US cities in terms of digital payment adoption, with only 49.1% of businesses accepting Apple Pay and only 10 businesses accepting cryptocurrency payments.

item.title: Big Bend Ranch State Park named top scenic camping spot
item.description: Big Bend Ranch State Park in Texas has been ranked as the 20th most scenic camping spot in the United States, according to a study.

item.title: Wine and wildlife: Saddlerock introduces unique animal safari
item.description: Saddlerock has combined their love of wine and animals by creating a safari tour that includes wine tastings and the opportunity to feed giraffes.

item.title: Black Sheep Coffee to open 20 new stores in Dallas-Fort Worth
item.description: Black Sheep Coffee has secured a 20-store development agreement to expand across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex over the next five years, led by franchise partner YOLOWAY, with locations planned in Richland Hills, Bedford, Plano, Garland, Rowlett, Mobile City, Sunnyvale, Richardson and Sachse.

item.title: Sip and sculpt: Learn bonsai at Dallas' Bonsai Bar
item.description: Bonsai Bar offers a beginner-friendly bonsai tree making class at Celestial Beer Works in Dallas, where participants can create their own unique bonsai tree while enjoying a drink.

item.title: Verified or Denied: Turning placemats into throw pillows
item.description: An internet hack claims that an ordinary cloth placemat can be turned into a throw pillow with some basic sewing skills and stuffing, and our test verified that it works.

item.title: Local bars discount Tullamore D.E.W. for St. Patrick's Day
item.description: Tullamore D.E.W. Irish Whiskey is celebrating St. Patrick's Day with drink specials and events at local venues, featuring discounted cocktails and themed parties.

item.title: Gotrax marks 7 million riders with G4 Pro scooter giveaway
item.description: GOTRAX, a personal electric vehicle company, has reached 7 million riders and is celebrating with a giveaway of two G4 Pro scooters.

item.title: Gusty winds and low moisture expected in Dallas-Fort Worth
item.description: Dallas-Fort Worth will experience gusty winds and low-level moisture, with a dry forecast and a mix of clouds and sunshine, high temperatures in the mid 70s, and some cloud cover returning tonight.

item.title: Parkland doctor shares lifesaving tips for American Heart Month
item.description: American Heart Month is being used to remind the public that immediate CPR and the use of defibrillators can significantly increase survival rates during cardiac emergencies.
